findings.description: The `hasOpenLedgerEntry` JSDoc still says "Every field is in the key", but the delta removed `accepted_by` from the WHERE clause, so the doc now contradicts the query.

Since dedupe no longer keys on `accepted_by`, an operator retry with the same reason and review-by after a conductor `--pr` run that failed partway files nothing new. The ledger keeps only the approver the conductor claimed, so the operator's own acceptance never gets recorded and they aren't told.

The `callingConductor` JSDoc edit left one line well past the paragraph's wrap width ("(it may gate with `--pr`, decision 75), the respawn and other projects; what it plans is recorded as its own. The"). Re-wrap the paragraph.

The amendment note on decision 47 is a parenthetical "(*amended by decision 75:* ...)" in mid-sentence. The other inline amendment (line 441) is a sentence-level "*Amended by decision 72:* ..." with a capital A and no parentheses.
